notes.title: Windows 11 initialisation bug fix
notes.notes:
In the Windows 11 operating system, an error could occur when starting the game, which led to incorrect initialization of the game, as a result of which the game subsystems began to work incorrectly. This error occurred when the game clearing old log files if the Documents folder was located in OneDrive, due to the fact that the game did not have enough rights to delete files and folders in this location.

To fix this error, it was decided to move the folder for recording and storing logs from *\Documents\Frameblade\Pinecone Game\Logs to %LocalAppData%\Frameblade\Pinecone Game\Logs

The old folder for storing logs will no longer be used and can be deleted manually if the game cannot do this automatically.

Discussion about this error: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1818150/discussions/0/600766842748866527/

notes.title: Update - 09.28.2024
notes.notes:
In honor of several players reached the score of 1000 pinecones, we decided to add a special reward into the game: now every player who managed to reach such an impressive number will receive a "Millennium" statuette, which will be a great decoration for the flying island.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653621/f0e64b05915ec3ec96f1ad9f46cfd12cb200ea3c.png

This statuette can be obtained in the in-game store (you will need to restart the game after reaching 1000 pinecones). Player named amossong, as the first who reached the 1000 pinecones mark, will receive a special personalized statuette.

 Now every time you throw a pinecone into the well, your account in the in-game store will be replenished by 1 pinecoin.

notes.title: The problem of leaderboard update was solved
notes.notes: The connection between the game server and the Steam servers has been broken. Communication has been restored. All pinecones thrown during the existence of the error have been saved - the score in the table will be updated to the current one at the next throw.
